executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 26 type incompatibility errors across 4 entity classes. The custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing the compiler to reject field annotations. All entity classes need to rename the custom Column class or use proper JPA annotations.

errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the Column entity class to BoardColumn or ColumnEntity to avoid naming conflict with javax.persistence.Column annotation. Update all references in entity classes and ensure proper @Entity and @Table annotations are present.
